name: The New Woody Woodpecker Show
description: The funny bird drives people crazy with his antics.

videos.title: Wiener Wars
videos.overview: Woody sells hotdogs after the original owner said he'd stop, however Wally doesn't agree with his idea.

videos.title: Electric Chilly
videos.overview: Chilly Willy causes serious problems for Smedly who attempts to open an amusement park.

videos.title: Woody and the Termite
videos.overview: Mother Nature says Woody's behind his pecking days so Woody hires a termite to do his job. This soon backfires when the termite decides to do mischief.

videos.title: Fake Vacation
videos.overview: Buzz Buzzard attempts to fool Woody by making a fake vacation where Woody would see hola-fraus. However, Woody then reports him for a scam for trying to steal his cash.

videos.title: Medical Winnie Pig
videos.overview: Winnie attempts to work at a doctors office but causes trouble instead.

videos.title: Cable Ace
videos.overview: Woody tries to watch his favorite show but it turns out Wally had The Highland Games channel.

videos.title: Ready for My Close-Up, Mr. Walrus
It's a Chilly Christmas After All
Niece and Quiet
videos.overview: Woody wants to nap in peace, but Ms. Meany makes him babysit her niece.

videos.title: Chilly Bananas
videos.overview: Chilly pollutes Hogwash's vacation in the biodome.

videos.title: Surf Crazy
videos.overview: Buzz and Tweaky's plan to win the big water race sinks when they try to cheat against Woody and Winnie.

videos.title: Birdhounded
videos.overview: Buzz gets a bird-brained idea to sell Woody to a scientist.

videos.title: Run Chilly, Run Deep
videos.overview: Chilly is in deep trouble when he disrupts Smedley's undersea treasure hunt.

videos.title: Surviving Woody
videos.overview: Woody and Ms. Meany must survive the game show "Extreme Island".

videos.title: Firehouse Woody
videos.overview: Woody gets fired up for some heated competition with a fireman trainee.

videos.title: Hogwash Junior
videos.overview: Chilly torments Hogwash's nephew while he trains for the Antarctic Corp.

videos.title: Thrash for Cash
videos.overview: Splinter and Knothead skateboard their way to stardom with Woody as their coach.

videos.title: Miniature Golf Mayhem
videos.overview: Buzz and Tweaky are no match for Woody when it comes to their golf con.

videos.title: A Chilly Cliffhanger
videos.overview: Smedley gets snowed by Chilly on a mountain climbing expedition.

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Night
videos.overview: To be on TV, Woody and Winnie spend the night in a haunted castle.
